filters.title.description: Heading and document title of the page of the user's keyword filters, and its item in the settings menu.

filters.list.title.description: Heading of the region of the user's keyword filters.

filters.description.defaultMessage: Fold or hide the posts that contain words you choose, whoever wrote them. Your own posts are never filtered.
filters.description.description: Note under the heading of the user's keyword filters: what a filter does.

filters.count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# filter} other {# filters}} of {max}
filters.count.description: Read for the count beside the heading of the keyword filters, drawn as '3 / 100'. {count} is the number of filters, {max} the most a user may have.

filters.empty.description: Heading of the empty state of the keyword filters.

filters.empty.description.defaultMessage: Add a filter to fold or hide the posts about a topic you would rather not read.
filters.empty.description.description: Sentence of the empty state of the keyword filters, which leads to adding one.

filters.add.description: Button that opens the form that adds a keyword filter, and the heading of that form.

filters.limit.defaultMessage: You have {max} filters, the most you can have. Delete one you no longer use to add another.
filters.limit.description: Shown in place of the button that adds a keyword filter once the user has the most. {max} is that number.

filters.added.description: Result above the list after a keyword filter was added. {title} is its name.

filters.saved.description: Announced after a keyword filter was changed. {title} is its name.

filters.deleted.description: Announced after a keyword filter was deleted. {title} is its name.

filters.row_action.description: Accessible name of a button of a keyword filter's row. {action} is the button's visible text (for example 'Edit'), {title} the filter's name.

filters.edit.description: Button of a keyword filter's row that opens the form that changes it.

filters.edit.title.description: Heading of the form that changes a keyword filter. {title} is its name.

filters.delete.description: Button of a keyword filter's row, and of its confirmation dialog, that deletes it.

filters.delete.title.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting a keyword filter. {title} is its name.

filters.delete.description.defaultMessage: Its words are deleted with it, and the posts it folds or hides show again.
filters.delete.description.description: Text of the dialog that confirms deleting a keyword filter.

filters.delete.cancel.description: Button that closes the dialog that confirms deleting a keyword filter.

filters.delete_failed.description: Toast when deleting a keyword filter failed. {title} is its name, {reason} the server's reason.

filters.action.warn.description: Badge of a keyword filter that folds the posts it matches, and the choice of that action in the form.

filters.action.hide.description: Badge of a keyword filter that leaves out the posts it matches, and the choice of that action in the form.

filters.expired.description: Badge of a keyword filter whose end has passed, so it applies nowhere.

filters.until.description: When a keyword filter stops applying, in its row. {date} is the date and time.

filters.contexts.description: Where a keyword filter applies, in its row. {contexts} is the list of places (for example 'Home and lists and Notifications').

filters.words.description: The words of a keyword filter, in its row. {count} is how many, {words} the list of them.

filters.words.more.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# word} other {# words}}: {words}, and {rest} more
filters.words.more.description: The words of a keyword filter with many words, in its row. {count} is how many, {words} the first ones, {rest} how many more there are.

filters.form.title.description: Label of the field of a keyword filter's name.

filters.form.title.description.defaultMessage: Shown on the posts it folds. Up to {max} characters.
filters.form.title.description.description: Description of the field of a keyword filter's name. {max} is the most characters.

filters.form.title.required.defaultMessage: Enter a name for the filter.
filters.form.title.required.description: Error of the empty name field of a keyword filter.

filters.form.title.too_long.description: Error of a keyword filter's name that is too long. {max} is the most characters.

filters.form.title.invalid.defaultMessage: Write the name on one line.
filters.form.title.invalid.description: Error of a keyword filter's name with a line break or another control character.

filters.form.words.description: Caption of the group of the words of a keyword filter.

filters.form.word.description: Label of one word field of a keyword filter. {number} is its position, starting at 1.

filters.form.word.required.defaultMessage: Enter a word, or remove this one.
filters.form.word.required.description: Error of an empty word field of a keyword filter.

filters.form.word.too_long.description: Error of a word of a keyword filter that is too long. {max} is the most characters.

filters.form.whole_word.description: Checkbox beside a word of a keyword filter: the word matches only where no letter or digit touches it.

filters.form.word.remove.description: Button that removes one word field from the keyword filter form. {number} is its position, starting at 1.

filters.form.word.add.description: Button that adds an empty word field to the keyword filter form.

filters.form.words.limit.defaultMessage: A filter has at most {max} words.
filters.form.words.limit.description: Shown beside the disabled button that adds a word once the filter has the most words. {max} is that number.

filters.form.whole_word.note.defaultMessage: In Japanese and Chinese, a whole word still matches inside other words.
filters.form.whole_word.note.description: One short line under the words of a keyword filter: whole-word matching does not apply to scripts without spaces between words.

filters.form.whole_word.help.description: Link to the page of the user manual on the documentation site that explains how the words of keyword filters match.

filters.form.contexts.description: Caption of the group of the places where a keyword filter applies.

filters.form.contexts.required.description: Error of a keyword filter with no place chosen.

filters.context.home.description: A place where a keyword filter applies: the home timeline and the timelines of lists.

filters.context.notifications.description: A place where a keyword filter applies: the notifications.

filters.context.public.description: A place where a keyword filter applies: the public timelines.

filters.context.thread.description: A place where a keyword filter applies: the posts before and after a post.

filters.context.account.description: A place where a keyword filter applies: the posts on a profile.

filters.form.action.description: Label of the choice of what a keyword filter does to the posts it matches.

filters.form.action.warn.description.defaultMessage: Folds the post behind the filter's name, with a button that shows it.
filters.form.action.warn.description.description: Description of the action that folds the posts a keyword filter matches.

filters.form.action.hide.description.defaultMessage: Leaves the post out. A post you open yourself is folded instead.
filters.form.action.hide.description.description: Description of the action that leaves out the posts a keyword filter matches.

filters.form.expiry.description: Label of the choice of when a keyword filter stops applying.

filters.form.expiry.never.description: The choice of a keyword filter that applies until it is deleted.

filters.form.expiry.keep.description: The choice that keeps the end a keyword filter has. {date} is that date and time.

filters.form.expiry.keep_expired.description: The choice that keeps the end of a keyword filter that has already expired.

filters.form.duration.minutes.defaultMessage: In {count, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}
filters.form.duration.minutes.description: A choice of when a keyword filter ends. {count} is the number of minutes from now.

filters.form.duration.hours.defaultMessage: In {count, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
filters.form.duration.hours.description: A choice of when a keyword filter ends. {count} is the number of hours from now.

filters.form.duration.days.defaultMessage: In {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
filters.form.duration.days.description: A choice of when a keyword filter ends. {count} is the number of days from now.

filters.form.add.description: Button that sends the form that adds a keyword filter.

filters.form.save.description: Button that sends the form that changes a keyword filter.

filters.form.cancel.description: Button that closes the form of a keyword filter without saving.

filters.form.failed.description: Error of the keyword filter form when the server refused it. {reason} is the server's reason.

filters.form.too_many_words.defaultMessage: Your filters have at most {max} words in all. Remove some words to save this filter.
filters.form.too_many_words.description: Error of the keyword filter form when the user's filters would have too many words. {max} is the most words in all.

filters.folded.description: In place of a post that matched keyword filters that fold, and the accessible name of the folded post. {titles} is the list of the filters' names.

filters.folded.show.description: Button of a post folded by a keyword filter that shows the post.
